description.value:
Your body transforms, becoming more elegant and distinguished. Tufts of fur grow longer and take on the texture of hanging moss. The points of your antlers elongate upwards, forming a crown of varying-height points above your head like a crystal chandelier.

  • Attribute Increase: Your Intelligence and Presence both increase by 1.
  • Botanical Creature: @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.abilities.GAIKNBY6N36Y6RO6]{Botanical Creature}
  • Ossified Aptitude: @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.abilities.FZ7JF27LF3N0UQ3T]{Ossified Aptitude}
  • Mind Over Matter: @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.abilities.Z96Q7Q8UM9BIS15N]{Mind Over Matter}
  • Magical Epiphany: You learn one cantrip and one spell of 3rd level or lower, regardless of class. Your spellcasting attribute for these spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Presence.
  • Font of Mana: @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.abilities.9695KHD24N6APCJQ]{Font of Mana}
